notes.notes:
🤩 Blueberry is part of the Women-Led Games event on Steam Dec 8th-15th! You can play the demo and give me feedback 👀 If you get to the end, post a screenshot/tag us, I will try my best to make you famous.

notes.title: Blueberry at Indie Arena Booth Gamescom 2024!
notes.notes: Are you going to Gamescom 2024? Visit us at hall 10, booth F010G-E019 in Cologne, Germany from 21-25 August and play the brand new demo at Indie Arena Booth. You can also play it on Steam NOW and during the Indie Arena Booth Gamescom event.

notes.title: Play the Blueberry Demo during Cat Awareness Steam Event 😻
notes.notes:
We take our role in building cat awareness very seriously and thus implemented the proven ability of a cat to reduce the blues in Blueberry 😻
Play the demo now and don't forget to pet the cat!

notes.title: Blueberry
notes.notes: Hang out and chat with us while we play the demo of Blueberry!

notes.title: Blueberry Animation Live Stream
notes.notes: Expressive character animation is one of the most important aspects of Blueberry's compelling emotional story. Watch Phoebe as she animates a character from the game and learn about how game character animation works.

notes.title: Rebroadcast: Blueberry Play and Develop Live Stream
notes.notes: Blueberry is a journey through a woman's mind from birth to death. We will play the first chapter of this heartfelt and emotional game, tell you about inspirations and personal stories, as well as giving you some insight in our development process. We invite you to chat, ask questions and tell us what you think!
